title: Notification NO.NPSC/ADVT-1/04 (VOL-1) dt. 18.06.2025 (Combined Technical Services Examination 2025)
text:
KEY LINES:
Notification NO.NPSC/ADVT-1/04 (VOL-1) dt. 18.06.2025 (Combined Technical Services Examination 2025) 
 Published on : 18-06-2025 01:02 pm 
 NO.NPSC/ADVT-1/04 (VOL-1) Dated, Kohima, the 18 th June, 2025 
 With reference to the Commission’s Advertisement No. NPSC-1/CTSE-2025 dated 7 th April, 2025 this is to notify all the candidates that Admission Certificate for the Written examination can be downloaded by logging into their NPSC web portal account at https://npsc.nagaland.gov.in from 19 th June, 2025 noon onwards and Candidates requiring assistance can call up the NPSC helpdesk number 9402988506 (10:00 AM to 3:00 PM) on working days.

Notification NO.NPSC/ADVT-1/04 (VOL-1) dt. 18.06.2025 (Combined Technical Services Examination 2025) 
 Published on : 18-06-2025 01:02 pm 
 NAGALAND PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION 
 KOHIMA 
 NO.NPSC/ADVT-1/04 (VOL-1) Dated, Kohima, the 18 th June, 2025 
 NOTIFICATION 
 With reference to the Commission’s Advertisement No. NPSC-1/CTSE-2025 dated 7 th April, 2025 this is to notify all the candidates that Admission Certificate for the Written examination can be downloaded by logging into their NPSC web portal account at https://npsc.nagaland.gov.in from 19 th June, 2025 noon onwards and Candidates requiring assistance can call up the NPSC helpdesk number 9402988506 (10:00 AM to 3:00 PM) on working days. 
(NUNGSANGMENLA IMCHEN) 
Secretary, 
Nagaland Public Service Commission, 
Kohima
